title: Retire orphan account navigation without losing operator and preview controls

source.ref: Runtime-root orphan graph + active feature reconciliation

detail: Removed seven unrooted legacy account/mobile/nav/context UI modules after reconciling destinations, theme controls and current mobile registry. Restored missing identity/context, downgrade-only role preview and per-member demo preference controls in the active Frequency avatar sheet, supplied by real server-resolved context/roles. Native selects remain inside the account dialog focus boundary. Existing server actions retain independent authorization and cookie checks. Migrated stale cache/header/tab/rail/account guards to active consumers; no empty-file pass. Source, mocked UI/action authority tests only; no production mutation or authenticated browser acceptance claim.

verify.note: Pins live layout-to-shell-to-account wiring, downgrade options and retired-module absence; rendered and actual server-action authority tests run in normal CI.
